Form.Description:
ROMARR - The Ultimate ROM Automation & Management Tool
A single self-contained container for managing your entire retro gaming library. Built on a proven, production-grade automation stack with no external dependencies.
Core Features: - Complete Import Pipeline: Automated detection and import of completed downloads from any supported client. - Unified Cataloguing: Automatic metadata, artwork, and ROM association. - Multi-Indexer Search: Simultaneous search across all connected indexers. - Direct Client Integration: Native support for qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, and rTorrent. - External Platform API (v1.0): Cartridge and custom frontends can submit game requests through the native search + grab pipeline. - Built-In Web Interface: Full management and browsing UI, served internally on port 8090. - Zero External Services Required: No Radarr, No Sonarr, No manual scraping.
Supported Platforms: MAME, FBNEO, CPS1/2/3, GGC, GBA/SP, GB/GBC, NDS, NES, SNES, 3DO, PSX, PS2, Wii, WiiU, Dreamcast, Saturn, Sega32X, Sega CD, N64, Xbox, Jaguar, PSP, PS1, GameCube, Genesis, SMS, Master System
Configuration: 1. Download Client: qBittorrent/Transmission/Deluge/rTorrent host, port, and API credentials (optional for most clients). 2. Download Watcher: Enable for automatic import. Download path: /downloads (standard Unraid path). 3. Library: Library path for your ROMs: /data/roms (mounted volume). 4. Indexers: Configure any number of indexers in the web UI after first launch. 5. Notifications: Enable Discord / Telegram / Gotify for download + import alerts.

Variable.Name: CLIENT_TYPE

Variable.Label: Download Client Type

Variable.Name: CLIENT_IP
Variable.Description: The IP address or hostname of your download client on your network.
Variable.Label: Download Client Host

Variable.Name: CLIENT_PORT
Variable.Description: The port your download client is listening on.
Variable.Label: Download Client Port

Variable.Name: CLIENT_USER
Variable.Description: API username for your download client. Leave blank for Transmission/Deluge/rTorrent.
Variable.Label: Download Client User

Variable.Name: CLIENT_PASS
Variable.Description: API password for your download client. Leave blank if not using authentication.
Variable.Label: Download Client Password

Variable.Name: WATCHER_ENABLE

Variable.Label: Enable Download Watcher

Variable.Name: DOWNLOAD_PATH
Variable.Description: The path where your download client stores completed files.
Variable.Label: Download Path

Variable.Name: LIBRARY_PATH
